story.iWant: to consolidate complex Docker bindings behind simple task verbs
story.soThat: developers don't have to memorize explicit environmental docker paths for booting up
story.tasks: - Construct `Taskfile.yaml` within the project root - Provide `up` command wrapping `docker compose ... up -d` - Provide `down` command wrapping `docker compose ... down` - Provide `logs` and `ps` quality-of-life additions.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Taskfile cleanly points context flags exclusively toward `infra/docker-compose.yml` and `infra/.env` variables.
